per_rule.rule: S_N must not be null
S_N must be unique across all records
S_N must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N (one-to-one consistency)
Account_No must not be null
Account_No must be a 4-digit numeric code
Account_No must not be duplicated (flag for business review)
Name must not be null
Name must be in Title Case (flag all-uppercase or all-lowercase values)
Name cultural particles must be consistent with Gender (Bin/s/o indicate Male; Binte/d/o indicate Female)
ID_No must not be null
ID_No must conform to Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one uppercase letter (S,T,F,G), 7 digits, one uppercase checksum letter
Race must not be null
Race must be one of the standard Singapore ethnic categories
Race must be standardized to Title Case (flag MALAY, malay, indian)
Gender must not be null
Gender must be Male or Female
Gender must be standardized to Title Case (flag male, FEMALE)
Age must not be null
Age must be numeric (flag non-numeric text like 'Twenty-five')
Age must be between 0 and 120 years (inclusive)
Age must not be negative
Age should be at least 13 years for service account validity
Contact_No must not be null
Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number
Contact_No local number must contain exactly 8 digits
Email must not be null
Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no whitespace
Email must be lowercase (flag mixed or uppercase characters)
Country must not be null
Country must use the canonical values: Republic of Singapore, S'pore, SG, Singapore, Singapura, 新加坡
Street_Name must not be null
Street_Name must be in Title Case (flag all-uppercase values)
Postal_Code must not be null
Postal_Code must be a 6-digit code
Account_No must match the corresponding Account_No in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
ID_No must match the corresponding ID in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
Name must match the corresponding Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N (allowing for case differences)
ID_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
